paragraphs.text: The Fall of Sarinth was an event that happened after many years of siege.

Ashnod had been sent by Mishra to obtain the city's oil and lumber resources, but was refused. Mishra ordered Ashnod to stay until the city was convinced to give up its resources, which it did not, effectually forcing her to lay siege to the city. As the years went on, more and more Fallaji forces were diverted to the siege to keep it effective, which also meant that Mishra had to release pressure from other places, enabling the Liberation of Yotia and forcing Mishra to relocate from his fortress to Tomakul .
It was late 43 AR when the city finally fell. Its people pacified and its resources plundered, Sarinth was forced to send their people as soldiers to the frontlines of the war outside Tomakul.
